authority.deployment_receipt_store: PostgreSQL model activation inbox and ACK ledger

invariants: every edge binds immutable IDs and SHA-256 digests
dataset event time and source watermark are at or before the coordinated as_of
graph snapshots exclude nodes and edges observed after as_of
metadata registration does not publish activation
activation requires a ready compatible consumer and durable ACK
feedback never rewrites the dataset, run, artifact or evaluation that produced a prediction
rollback selects a previous immutable model version and never mutates artifact bytes
